name: Waveshare E-Paper ESP32 Driver Board + 7.5" B/W
description: Waveshare's universal E-Paper ESP32 Driver Board (classic ESP32-WROOM-32, 4 MB flash, no PSRAM) carrying a 7.5 inch monochrome panel (7.5inch e-Paper V2, 800x480). Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API and paints a raw 1-bpp mono buffer (48000 bytes) produced by the esp32_bw_bin renderer; byte-identical wire contract to the Seeed reTerminal E1001 and the XIAO 7.5 inch boards. Distinct kind because the classic-ESP32 firmware image has its own OTA lineage. No battery telemetry (the board has no divider to an ADC pin) and no user buttons beyond EN and BOOT.
notes_md:
Firmware support is in tesserae-device-firmware from v1.32.0 as the `waveshare-esp32-driver-75` build; community bring-up, not yet confirmed on real hardware. Wire format is exactly 48000 bytes (800*480/8), MSB=leftmost pixel, bit-set=white, bit-clear=black; no header, no padding, no checksum. Frame is byte-identical to the `xiao_epaper_75`, `xiao_epaper_panel_75_c3` and `seeed_reterminal_e1001` targets. Default device ids look like `waveshare_esp32_driver_75_<mac-suffix>` (model string `Waveshare_ESP32_Driver_75`). OTA-capable; descriptors are signed for this kind id.

**Board switches.** Waveshare's wiki says DIP switch 1 (Display Config) must sit at the 0.47R "B" position for the 7.5 inch panel; the 3R "A" position is for the small panels and gives a faint or blank image. Switch 2 powers the USB-UART bridge and must be ON to flash or to see the serial console.

**Panel fit.** The firmware drives the 7.5 inch V2 (UC8179, 800x480). Waveshare's older 7.5 inch V1 (640x384) and the tri-colour (B) and (C) panels are not this kind.

**No battery reporting.** The board's 5V pin accepts 3.6-5.5 V so it can run from a cell, but nothing on the board measures it, so the firmware omits `battery_pct` and the server shows no battery UI for this kind.

**No buttons.** EN and BOOT only, so no button-report mappings, no page-turn bindings and no Bluetooth setup path; Wi-Fi provisioning is the captive portal.
